Data Migration Developer – Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse
Intelex Developer
description:
Job Summary
 



 We are looking for an experienced Intelex Developer to design, develop, configure, customize, and maintain applications and workflows within the Intelex platform. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with Intelex configuration, development, integrations, and troubleshooting, along with a strong understanding of business requirements.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Configure and customize Intelex applications based on business requirements.
 



 \* Develop and maintain workflows, forms, reports, dashboards, and business rules.
 



 \* Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
 



 \* Develop and maintain integrations between Intelex and other enterprise applications.
 



 \* Troubleshoot application issues and provide timely resolutions.
 



 \* Perform testing, debugging, and deployment of Intelex solutions.
 



 \* Maintain technical documentation for configurations, customizations, and integrations.
 



 \* Support upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing optimization of the Intelex platform.
 



 \* Collaborate with functional teams, developers, QA, and business stakeholders.
 



 \* Follow development standards, security practices, and change\-management procedures.
 



  





 Required Skills
 



  





 \* Hands\-on experience with the Intelex platform.
 



 \* Strong understanding of Intelex configuration and customization.
 



 \* Experience with workflows, forms, reports, dashboards, and business rules.
 



 \* Knowledge of SQL/database concepts.
 



 \* Experience with REST APIs/web services and system integrations.
 



 \* Understanding of JavaScript or other relevant scripting technologies.
 



 \* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
 



 \* Good communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



  





 Good to Have
 



  





 \* Experience integrating Intelex with ERP, HRMS, CRM, or other enterprise systems.
 



 \* Knowledge of cloud\-based applications and APIs.
 



 \* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
 



 \* Experience working on EHSQ (Environment, Health \& Safety, Quality) applications.
 



  





 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 \* Strong problem\-solving ability.
 



 \* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
 



 \* Good attention to detail.
 



 \* Ability to understand business processes and convert them into scalable technical solutions.
